name: How long does it take to finish a garage interior?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to finish a garage interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for finishing a garage interior depends on the project's scope and the size of the garage. A basic finish (drywall, paint, flooring) might take 2-4 weeks. More extensive projects involving custom cabinetry, plumbing, or significant electrical work could extend to 4-8 weeks or longer. We provide a detailed project schedule after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finishing a garage interior can take 2-8 weeks or more, depending on project scope and garage size.
